sentences.Viola er på besøk hos venninna Synne, og: Viola is visiting her friend Synne, and they are sitting in Synne's room listening to music.
sentences.Synne snakker hele tida, men Viola sier: Synne talks all the time, but Viola doesn't say much.
sentences.Du er stille i dag. Er det noe i veien?: You're quiet today. Is something wrong?
sentences.Noe i veien? Hva betyr det?: "Noe i veien"? What does that mean?
sentences.Har du en dårlig dag?: Are you having a bad day?
sentences.Ja, jeg er kjempetrøtt. Det var en trave: Yes, I'm really tired. It was a busy day yesterday.
sentences.Jeg hadde kjempemye å gjøre. Foreldrene: I had loads to do. The parents were at work for a long time, and I looked after the two boys, who are two and four.
sentences.Jeg skjønner. Liker du å jobbe som au pa: I see. Do you like working as an au pair?
sentences.Ja, vanligvis liker jeg det veldig godt,: Yes, usually I like it very much, but yesterday was a very busy day.
sentences.Først laget jeg frokost og smurte matpak: First I made breakfast and packed lunches for the boys. Then we ate, and I dropped the boys off at kindergarten. Then I was at the Norwegian course for five hours. After school I went to the library with a girl from my class and did homework.
sentences.Vi leste og pugget verb. Etterpå hentet: We read and learned verbs by heart. Afterwards I picked up the boys from kindergarten at four o'clock, and I made dinner for us.
sentences.Slappet du av om kvelden, da?: Did you relax in the evening, then?
sentences.Nei. Guttene lekte og rotet, og jeg rydd: No. The boys played and made a mess, and I tidied up and washed the floor. In the end I fell asleep on the sofa, because I was so tired.
sentences.Huff, det var en slitsom dag! Du trenger: Oh dear, what a tiring day! You need to relax this evening.
sentences.Viola hadde en travel dag i går og jobbe: Viola had a busy day yesterday and worked a lot.
sentences.Om morgenen laget hun frokost og leverte: In the morning she made breakfast and dropped the boys off at kindergarten.
sentences.Etterpå var hun på norskkurs og på bibli: Afterwards she was at the Norwegian course and at the library.
sentences.Så hentet hun guttene i barnehagen og la: Then she picked up the boys from kindergarten and made dinner.
sentences.Viola ryddet huset, for guttene rotet my: Viola tidied the house, because the boys made a big mess.
In the end she fell asleep on the sofa.
There are many libraries in Norway.
sentences.På biblioteket kan du låne bøker på mang: At the library you can borrow books in many different languages, read newspapers and use computers.
sentences.På biblioteket kan de hjelpe deg med å f: At the library they can help you find books.
sentences.Noen bibliotek har leksehjelp, språkkafé: Some libraries offer homework help, language cafés and other services for immigrants.
sentences.I noen byer har biblioteket også temadag: In some towns the library also has theme days with activities for children.
